elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added operative clause states: “On expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form, Vendor shall provide transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: The clause requires assistance for at least ninety days but does not give Customer a right to assistance for up to 6 months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause does not specify any rates or charges for transition assistance.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Vendor to “export all Customer Data to Customer” upon expiry or termination, which substantively provides for return to Customer.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires export of all Customer Data within thirty days.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete it.
elements.evidence: The operative language contains no deletion obligation.

elements.element: Vendor must certify the deletion of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The operative language contains no deletion-certification obligation.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly requires Vendor to provide transition assistance on expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Order Form.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The clause requires transition assistance “for at least ninety days,” which includes the required 90-day period.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly requires Vendor to export all Customer Data to Customer upon expiry or termination.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data within 30 days.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly requires the export within thirty days.

result.reason: The operative addition fully reaches the fallback but omits the preferred six-month period, then-current rates, machine-readable format, deletion, and deletion certification. It preserves the existing commercial terms and creates no direct contradiction. It is not strictly minimal because “at least ninety days” is open-ended beyond the specified 90-day fallback, and the drafting leaves the assistance period’s endpoint and service mechanics unclear.
